topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I've just found out that my online friend, who I've been talking to for months, actually lives in the same city as me. It’s a small world, isn’t it? I mean, the chances of this happening are so slim, yet here we are. I think it’s amazing, and I’m sure we’ll find a way to meet up, maybe grab coffee or something. But I keep thinking about how it will go. What if it’s awkward? We’ve always just chatted online, sharing thoughts and jokes. It’s a whole different ball game meeting in person. I guess I’ll just take it one step at a time and see where it goes.
